NCERT Releases New Class 9 Textbooks for Math and Social Science

The National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT) has launched revised textbooks for Class 9 Mathematics and Social Science for the 2026-27 academic session. The Mathematics book is available, while the Social Science textbook will be available from September 30. This release comes amid criticism over delays.
